description: This file defines enums and a singleton-like struct for managing onboarding state within an iOS application. It includes connection mode options, onboarding state persistence, and flags for first-time user experiences.

methods.name: shouldPresentOnLaunch
methods.description: Determines if onboarding should be presented on app launch based on completion status, previous connection, and app model.

methods.name: markCompleted
methods.description: Marks onboarding as completed and records the mode and timestamp.

methods.name: shouldPresentFirstRunIntro
methods.description: Checks if the first run introduction should be shown.

methods.name: markFirstRunIntroSeen
methods.description: Sets the flag indicating the first run intro has been seen.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets onboarding completion and first run flags.

methods.name: lastMode
methods.description: Retrieves the last connection mode used during onboarding.
